evals.name: academic-paper
evals.prompt: I have this LaTeX paper I wrote for a conference. Can you convert it to a clean Word docx? It's at /tmp/latex2word-test/paper.tex
evals.expected_output: A .docx file with proper sections, inline and display math formulas, a table with borders, a figure placeholder, footnotes, citations as footnotes, and a bibliography section. Title page with author info.

evals.name: multi-file-thesis
evals.prompt: Please convert my thesis LaTeX project to Word format. The main file is at /tmp/latex2word-test/thesis/main.tex. It has multiple chapters included via \include. Make sure to merge all the chapters into a single docx with a TOC.
evals.expected_output: A .docx file with a table of contents, all chapters merged in order, section headings preserved, math formulas, and a bibliography at the end.

evals.name: complex-environments
evals.prompt: Here's a LaTeX document with advanced environments that I need in Word format: /tmp/latex2word-test/complex.tex. It has theorem/proof environments, align equations, matrices, code listings with syntax highlighting, colored text, and a custom command. Please convert it preserving as much structure as possible.
evals.expected_output: A .docx file with theorem/proof blocks formatted with bold/italic labels, aligned equations, matrix rendered as table or formula, code listing in monospace with gray background, colored text preserved, and custom command expanded.
